# Cncf Ejbca Community Reviewer

Review EJBCA Community using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Issue certificates for all your Kubernetes workloads with the open-source public key infrastructure (PKI) and certificate authority (CA) software EJBCA.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
